sections.title: What's new
items: No changes to the copilot itself — this release delivers its authoring wiki (vision through next tasks, plus the assembly and TWAP-extension prompts) into copies installed before doc seeding existed.

sections.title: What's new
items: A copilot grounded in your real Coinbase portfolio — it thinks, you decide.
Live balances and prices flow through a connection you approve field by field.
Desktop only: Coinbase’s API is reached with native fetch, not the browser.
